narrative.question:
Which of the HRA's 1,730 Uberon-keyed anatomical structures (2,295 raw
ASCT+B-3D crosswalk rows, 114 source-organ GLBs) are covered by a
mechanistic model — at a single query's scale and at the full
1,096-model curated-corpus scale — and can we view that coverage/linkage
directly on the 3D anatomy?

decisions.title: Which HRA organs/FTUs have ZERO mechanistic models (the modeling white-space)?
decisions.detail: Full-corpus coverage reaches 31/114 organs (27.2%); the other 83 organs, and finer sub-organ FTUs beyond glomerulus, are not yet enumerated as a prioritized gap list.

decisions.title: Does organ-granularity coverage overstate AS-level coverage — can we get finer?
decisions.detail: A covered organ's Uberon marks every AS node cut from its GLB as covered, whether or not that specific sub-structure has direct model evidence; 18.3% of crosswalk rows are structurally un-keyable (organizational nodes), a hard ceiling on how fine coverage can ever get.

decisions.title: Can we spatially link model RESULTS (steady-state values) to AS, not just presence?
decisions.detail: spatial-linkage's `readout` field is a literal placeholder string ('pending time-series') for all 10 links in v1 — the join topology (model -> AS node) works, but no simulation output is wired to a node yet.
